whyBuy.title: Why **Instagram Comments Are the Strongest Engagement Signal**
whyBuy.body:
Of all engagement types on Instagram, comments carry the most algorithmic weight. A post with strong comment activity tells Instagram that people are not just scrolling past but actively reacting and engaging. That signal triggers wider distribution across hashtags, the Explore page, and follower feeds.

Likes are passive. Views are automatic. Comments require effort, and Instagram's algorithm treats them accordingly. A post with 50 genuine-looking comments will consistently outperform a post with 500 likes but no comments in terms of reach and distribution.

Here is what strong comment counts do for your posts:

- Send a high-value engagement signal to Instagram's algorithm
- Increase your post's visibility across hashtags and the Explore tab
- Make your content look active and worth joining for new visitors
- Encourage real users to leave their own comments when they see existing activity
- Strengthen your overall account engagement rate across future posts

items.question: Do Instagram comments boost reach more than likes?
items.answer: Yes. Comments carry more algorithmic weight than likes on Instagram. A comment requires active effort from a user, which Instagram interprets as a stronger signal of content quality. Posts with high comment activity are consistently pushed to wider audiences through hashtags and the Explore page compared to posts with only likes or views.
